howto.heading: Giving the key to your agent
howto.step1: Issue the key and copy it — it is shown once and cannot be read back afterwards.
howto.step2: Store it wherever your agent keeps its secrets. Never paste it into a public page, a chat, or your store content.

rotate.title: Rotate the agent key?
rotate.body: A new key is issued and the current one stops working immediately — there is no overlap period. Any agent still sending the old key will be refused from the next request until you give it the new one.

revoke.title: Revoke the agent key?
revoke.body: This removes the key entirely. Every agent using it is refused from the next request, and the key cannot be restored — a new one has to be issued and handed over again. If your agent is live, its checkout stops working the moment you confirm.
